purpose: Dataset QA scorecard for populated data-package samples (reports/DATA_PACKAGE_LICENSE_QA_REVIEW.md section 3). Implemented by tools/score_data_package_dataset.py. Covers the schema_and_structure, quality_and_cleanliness and provenance_and_rights families of config/data-package-maximal-testing-program.json for row-level data, plus synthesis-perspective checks from reports/DATA_PACKAGE_PRODUCT_PLAN.md section 4.
truth_boundary: A QA pass is integrity evidence for one dataset version. It is NOT the config/dataset_evaluation_scorecard.json score (scorecard_score), NOT validation evidence for license_provenance_gate.py, and NOT a sale approval. Never copy qa_score into scorecard_score.

status_rules.check_pass: metric >= pass_min for every metric of the check
status_rules.check_warn: every metric >= warn_min but at least one below pass_min
status_rules.check_not_run: required reference data absent (e.g. no --onet-csv-dir / --onet-zip); a hard check that is not_run fails the scorecard
status_rules.overall: fail if any hard check is fail or not_run; pass if every check passes; otherwise warn

completeness.description: Share of (row x required field) cells that are present and non-empty (null, '', [] and {} count as empty).

schema_validity.description: Every line parses as JSON and validates against the profile row schema with tools/minimal_json_schema.py.

referential_integrity.description: Every onet_soc_code exists in the pinned occupation_data.csv with the same title; every element_id exists in its source file with the same name; every importance value equals the source IM Data Value (rounded to 2 dp).

deduplication.description: No duplicate record_id or onet_soc_code; no two rows with an identical DreamCo synthesis payload (practice seed + rubric).

value_ranges.description: Importance within O*NET scales_reference IM [1,5]; job_zone within [1,5]; lens scores in [0,1]; top-k lists sorted descending by importance; preparation_band consistent with job_zone; soc_major_group equals the code prefix; dominant_lens equals the arg-max of lens_lift.

freshness_version_match.latest_known_source: https://www.onetcenter.org/db_releases.html ('The current production release of the O*NET database is 31.0')
freshness_version_match.description: Every row's source_version equals the package pin; every source_ref file_sha256 equals the asset provenance per-file pin (and, with reference data, the bytes actually read); the pin equals the latest known O*NET release (warn only, refresh latest_known_onet_version when O*NET publishes).

provenance_coverage.description: Per row: every field in license.onet_derived_fields is named by a source_ref whose source_id is pinned in the asset provenance.json with a sha256; every field in license.dreamco_fields is named by the dreamco_synthesis source_ref; the two field lists match the profile.

synthesis_perspective.description: DreamCo layer present (seed, >=3 rubric dimensions, analysis with >=1 agree or caveat and >=1 still_need_test); rows citing >=2 evidence perspectives (O*NET rating sources); no DreamCo text shares a run of >= verbatim_ngram_words words with that occupation's O*NET description or task statements; practice seeds are not copies of each other; DreamCo-derived fields are a real share of the row.
